name: Your AI Analyst Gave Two Right Answers. Only the SQL Said Why.
author: Saurabh Sharma
seo_title: AI Analyst Follow-Up Questions: Check Which Date It Used
meta_description: “Delivered in 2017” gave Dot two correct late-order counts on Olist data. A six-step test shows which date your analyst used, and where its SQL says so.

images_to_upload.alt: Bar chart of two Dot answers to how many orders delivered in 2017 were late, on the Olist dataset. In a follow-up chat, Dot used purchase date and returned 2,453. In a fresh chat, it used delivery date and returned 1,762.
